entries.title: Psalms 135:1
segments: Praise ye Jehovah. Praise ye the name of Jehovah; Praise [him], O ye servants of Jehovah,

entries.title: Psalms 135:2
segments: Ye that stand in the house of Jehovah, In the courts of the house of our God.

entries.title: Psalms 135:3
segments: Praise ye Jehovah; for Jehovah is good: Sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

entries.title: Psalms 135:4
segments: For Jehovah hath chosen Jacob unto himself, [And] Israel for his own possession.

entries.title: Psalms 135:5
segments: For I know that Jehovah is great, And that our Lord is above all gods.

entries.title: Psalms 135:6
segments: Whatsoever Jehovah pleased, that hath he done, In heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps;

entries.title: Psalms 135:7
segments: Who causeth the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth; Who maketh lightnings for the rain; Who bringeth forth the wind out of his treasuries;

entries.title: Psalms 135:8
segments: Who smote the first-born of Egypt, Both of man and beast;

entries.title: Psalms 135:9
segments: Who sent signs and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, Upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants;

entries.title: Psalms 135:10
segments: Who smote many nations, And slew mighty kings,

entries.title: Psalms 135:11
segments: Sihon king of the Amorites, And Og king of Bashan, And all the kingdoms of Canaan,

entries.title: Psalms 135:12
segments: And gave their land for a heritage, A heritage unto Israel his people.

entries.title: Psalms 135:13
segments: Thy name, O Jehovah, [endureth] for ever; Thy memorial [name], O Jehovah, throughout all generations.

entries.title: Psalms 135:14
segments: For Jehovah will judge his people, And repent himself concerning his servants.

entries.title: Psalms 135:15
segments: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, The work of men's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 135:16
segments: They have mouths, but they speak not; Eyes have they, but they see not;

entries.title: Psalms 135:17
segments: They have ears, but they hear not; Neither is there any breath in their mouths.

entries.title: Psalms 135:18
segments: They that make them shall be like unto them; Yea, every one that trusteth in them.

entries.title: Psalms 135:19
segments: O house of Israel, bless ye Jehovah: O house of Aaron, bless ye Jehovah:

entries.title: Psalms 135:20
segments: O house of Levi, bless ye Jehovah: Ye that fear Jehovah, bless ye Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 135:21
segments: Blessed be Jehovah out of Zion, Who dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye Jehovah.
